detail.longDescription: In every production incident whose root cause depended on concurrency, Claude Code announced a cause, shipped a fix, then walked it back. Each wrong guess cost a deploy cycle. Pinto (Nov 12), 8 DB incidents: all 5 concurrency cases had an access gap, and its wrong hypotheses fit what it could see. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.17304 Whoever can read pg_locks should watch the run. shell --name incident claude prints a link: https:// shell.online # AIAgents # PostgreSQL # DevOps
